framing: For each field in order: unsigned 32-bit big-endian byte length followed by UTF-8 bytes, then SHA-256 lowercase hex of concatenation.
relationPolicy: 1..128 Unicode code points, <=512 UTF-8 bytes. Preserve exact valid bytes/case; no normalization or silent trimming. Reject blanks, leading/trailing Unicode White_Space, C0/C1 controls including DEL, and unpaired UTF-16 surrogate code units.
requestPolicy: Strict exactly three fields, no duplicate JSON keys, nested data or authority. Reject self-link. Lowercase canonical UUIDs in responses/hash.
persistentModel: MemoryAssociation (normal generated entity/repository/service, not x-thorapi-nonCrud; raw generic HTTP CRUD/read must be denied)
generatedFields: ThorAPI owns id, ownerId and audit fields; do not redefine them in canonical schema.
identity: Server random generated UUID id exposed as associationRef; writeKeyHash frames authenticated owner + canonical scope + tupleHash + both server-owned source incarnation identities (source owner and original creation timestamp). The client supplies no identity/scope/key. Same authorized tuple reuses same row/ref after text correction; deletion/recreation is a different incarnation.
foreignKeys: from_id and to_id -> same-schema actual memory_entry.id, both physical ON DELETE CASCADE; named fk_memassoc_from and fk_memassoc_to. Probe real target table/column/catalog/schema and deleteRule, not name alone. Require constraints/unique before capability supported or write acknowledgement in Lite, Cloud tenant and CORE/main.
schemaEndpointExtension: x-graymatter-association-endpoint: MemoryEntry on each UUID endpoint; x-graymatter-association-delete-rule: CASCADE on model. Keep free-form label separate from GraphLink relationType/semanticKind.
authorization: Authenticate first. Lite source rows must both belong to current persisted PrincipalRecord. Cloud resolve scope/server actor, generated READ on both sources plus current generated source/association create entitlement, same canonical source tenant plane. Edge owner remains creating principal, even for shared endpoints. Every existing replay and GET rechecks owner/scope and both endpoints, trashed/expired/lifecycle. Do not cache authority or automatically restore grants.
commit: Source locks ordered UUID and refresh+reauthorize in same real transaction as association insert/reuse; DB unique protects races; return receipt only after commit. Generic/nested association record JSON writes/reads and admin JsonCrud must not bypass current endpoint policy. Never enumerate foreign edges.
mcp: Preserve private memory_link 3-string shape and public catalog freeze. Capability fixed path before any write; POST once with no auth/schema reissue, forbid redirects and origin changes; exact same-origin receipt GET after POST; verify exact tuple/hash/ref/time/protocol before status linked. Unsupported capability can report not sent. Any uncertain POST/readback result is unverified, never not-recorded or linked. No denied IDs/labels/error bodies echoed.
